select distinct productId from attribute_content where
(attribute_content.parentId = #{attributeContents.parentId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and attribute_content.content= #{attributeContents.content})

SELECT productId from attribute_content where concat(attribute_content.content) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{str},'%')
and parentId in(select id from attribute_name where parentId = #{parentId})

SELECT productId from attribute_content where concat(attribute_content.content) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{str})
and parentId in(select id from attribute_name where parentId = #{parentId})
and parentId in(select id from attribute_name where unit = #{unit})

SELECT fin_product_id as productId from fin_attribute_content where concat(fin_attribute_content.fin_att_content) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{str},'%')
and fin_att_name_id in(select id from fin_attribute_name where fin_sort_id = #{parentId})

SELECT fin_product_id as productId from fin_attribute_content where concat(fin_attribute_content.fin_att_content) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{str})
and fin_att_name_id in(select id from fin_attribute_name where fin_sort_id = #{parentId})
and fin_att_name_id in(select id from fin_attribute_name where fin_att_unit = #{unit})

select count(*),parentId ,content from attribute_content where (parentId,binary content) in
(#{attributeValues.attNameId,jdbcType=INTEGER},#{attributeValues.attValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
group by parentId,content

select a.*,attribute_name.name,unit from ( select attribute_content.*,0 as vault from attribute_content where (productId,0) in
(#{applicationContents.productId,jdbcType=INTEGER},#{applicationContents.vault,jdbcType=INTEGER}) ) as a left join attribute_name on a.parentId = attribute_name.id
union all select b.*,fin_attribute_name.fin_att_name as name,fin_att_unit as unit from ( select id, fin_att_name_id as parentId,fin_product_id as productId,fin_att_content as content,1 as vault from fin_attribute_content where (fin_product_id,1) in
(#{applicationContents.productId,jdbcType=INTEGER},#{applicationContents.vault,jdbcType=INTEGER}) ) as b left join fin_attribute_name on b.parentId = fin_attribute_name.id

select attribute_content.*,name from attribute_content LEFT JOIN attribute_name on attribute_content.parentId = attribute_name.id where productId = #{id} and 0=#{vault} and (name='品牌' or name='封装') union all select fin_attribute_content.*,fin_att_name as name from fin_attribute_content LEFT JOIN fin_attribute_name on fin_attribute_content.fin_att_name_id = fin_attribute_name.id where fin_product_id = #{id} and 1=#{vault} and (fin_att_name='品牌' or fin_att_name='封装')

select attribute_content.*,name from attribute_content LEFT JOIN attribute_name on attribute_content.parentId = attribute_name.id where productId = #{id} and 0=#{vault} and name!='存放位置' union all select fin_attribute_content.*,fin_att_name as name from fin_attribute_content LEFT JOIN fin_attribute_name on fin_attribute_content.fin_att_name_id = fin_attribute_name.id where fin_product_id = #{id} and 1=#{vault} and fin_attribute_name.fin_att_name !='存放位置'
